comparisons.peer_topic: Services and non-consolidation of customer TOB trusts
comparisons.peer_summary: The Firm provides services such as remarketing agent and liquidity provider for customer TOB trusts but does not consolidate these entities due to lack of power to significantly impact their economic performance. While the Firm acts as a liquidity provider and has recourse to third-party residual holders for shortfalls upon termination, it does not intend to protect residual holders from potential losses on the underlying municipal bonds.
comparisons.comparison: Both Citi and JPMorgan disclose acting as a tender option provider or liquidity provider for TOB trusts, enabling investors to put interests back. However, they differ in the specific counterparties and risk structures described: Citi explicitly serves as the tender option provider for 'non-customer' TOB trusts, allowing Floater holders to put to the Company at par. JPMorgan provides these services to 'customer' TOB trusts (sponsored by third parties) and notes a specific recourse arrangement with third-party Residual holders for shortfalls, whereas it explicitly states no intent to protect residual holders from losses on underlying bonds.

sentences.text: For certain other non-customer TOB trusts, Citi serves as tender option provider.
The tender option provider arrangement allows Floater holders to put their interests directly to the Company at any time, subject to the requisite notice period requirements, at a price of par.
The Firm may provide various services to customer TOB trusts, including remarketing agent, liquidity or tender option provider.
In certain customer TOB transactions, the Firm, as liquidity provider, has entered into a reimbursement agreement with the Residual holder.
In those transactions, upon the termination of the vehicle, the Firm has recourse to the third-party Residual holders for any shortfall.

comparisons.peer_topic: Liquidity facilities for Municipal Tender Option Bonds
comparisons.peer_summary: Short-term securities are supported by a liquidity facility allowing investors to put their interests; while typically provided by a third-party, the Firm may provide this facility in some programs, and these facilities are classified as derivatives.
comparisons.comparison: Both disclosures concern the provision of liquidity facilities for Municipal Tender Option Bonds (TOBs). Citi acts as the tender option provider for non-customer trusts, allowing put options at par. Morgan Stanley similarly provides liquidity facilities for short-term securities in some programs, allowing investors to put interests, but distinguishes itself by noting that while third-party providers are typical, the Firm may provide this facility in some programs, and explicitly classifies these facilities as derivatives.

sentences.text: For certain other non-customer TOB trusts, Citi serves as tender option provider.
The tender option provider arrangement allows Floater holders to put their interests directly to the Company at any time, subject to the requisite notice period requirements, at a price of par.
The short-term securities are supported by a liquidity facility pursuant to which the investors may put their short-term interests.
In most programs, a third-party provider will provide such liquidity facility; in some programs, the Firm provides this liquidity facility.
Liquidity facilities provided to municipal tender option bond trusts are classified as derivatives.
